blocking_issues.problem: Plan section 6 acceptance criterion 3 requires this test to prove that "a fresh `rr.stations().data` provider slice remains frame-equal with exact CRS values `["unknown"]`", and plan section 8 forbids the implementation from writing any catalogue back. The re-read is not fresh: packaged catalogues are loaded once by `_ensure_default_providers_registered` (src/rivretrieve/_internal/discovery.py:223-346) into the module-level registry, and `rr.stations()` (discovery.py:134) serves that in-process copy. Both the `stations_before` and the `stations_after` reads therefore return the same cached frame, so the assertion pair cannot observe a persisted write-back at all. It is the only check the plan designates as the no-write-back evidence, and against the exact failure mode the vision names (map() persisting an assumed EPSG:4326 frame into the packaged station catalogue) it discriminates nothing.
